How to get it :
- [[Arc Welder|Arc Welder]] : 4 x Aluminium Plate, 4 x Fiberglass Bar, ingot (hard plastic).
- [[Arc Welder|Arc Welder]] : 2 x Titanium Plate, 4 x Fiberglass Bar, ingot (hard plastic).

Used to make :
[[gv:satellite_science_assembler|Space Laboratory - 0G Assembler]], [[gv:satellite_miner_astro|Asteroid Mining Ship]], [[gv:satellite_death_ray|Orbital Death Ray]], [[gv:satellite_detector|Wideband Radio Emission Detector Satellite]], [[gv:missile_soyuz_lander|Orbital Module]], [[gv:satellite_miner_lunar|Lunar Mining Ship]], [[gv:satellite_precision_laser|Orbital Precision Laser]], [[gv:satellite_radar|Radar Satellite]], [[gv:satellite_ray_scan|Narrowband Emission Scanning Satellite]], [[gv:satellite_relay|RoR Relay Satellite]] and 6 more.
